title: Shared messaging tabs: change tab keys, content, and header actions together across both scenes
answers: How do I add a new shared tab to Workflows and Broadcasts?
Where is the header button for Library/Channels/Opt-outs tabs defined?
Tabs jump between Workflows and Broadcasts pages
body:
Shared tabs (library, channels, opt-outs, suppression, reputation) are defined once in products/workflows/frontend/messagingTabs.tsx: MESSAGING_NAV_TAB_KEYS, MESSAGING_TAB_CONTENT, and messagingNavTabs(linkFor). Each scene passes its own link builder (urls.workflows(tab) / urls.broadcasts(tab)) so tabs stay within the surface.
Header buttons live in products/workflows/frontend/MessagingTabActions.tsx (MessagingTabActions, takes channelsUrl for the Slack authorize `next` return); both WorkflowsScene and BroadcastsScene render it.
Adding or renaming a tab means updating: the keys array (path segments are pinned; renaming breaks bookmarks), content map, MessagingTabActions, and the literal routes for BOTH /workflows and /broadcasts in manifest.tsx (+ regenerated products.tsx).
BroadcastsScene derives the current tab from the last pathname segment, since the routes are literal, not params.
applies: products/workflows shared messaging tabs in WorkflowsScene and BroadcastsScene
says: New messaging tab appears in one section only
